closure_summary.admission_note: ESCALATION (per spec Sec 'Escalate'): the FULL match_annotation closure, verified by source, is substantially larger and deeper than the corpus's starting enumeration and appears to EXCEED the |gold|<=60 admission ceiling. Three findings not in the starting enumeration: (1) the ~10 named wrappers are actually 12 (is_list/is_dict/is_int/is_float/is_string/is_bytes/is_set/is_tuple/is_io_base/is_pathlib_path/is_fastapi_route/is_type_var_like) plus a 13th hop-0 direct forwarder is_io_base_expr (calls IoBaseChecker::match_initializer directly, bypassing check_type); (2) THREE lint-rule files define their OWN local TypeChecker impls and call check_type directly, bypassing the is_* layer entirely: HttpxClientChecker (flake8_async/rules/blocking_http_call_httpx.rs:59), a locally-scoped PathlibPathChecker distinct from typing.rs's own (flake8_async/rules/blocking_path_methods.rs:161), and SameClassInstanceChecker (flake8_self/rules/private_member_access.rs:278, reached via forwarder is_same_class_instance); (3) two of the twelve wrapper families have their own long same-file forwarder sub-chains before reaching a terminal consumer -- is_type_var_like: typing.rs -> class.rs::might_be_old_style_typevar_like -> class.rs::expr_might_be_old_style_typevar_like -> class.rs::expr_might_be_typevar_like -> class.rs::might_be_generic -> flake8_pyi/non_self_return_type.rs (5 more hops); is_fastapi_route: typing.rs -> fastapi/rules/mod.rs::is_fastapi_route_call -> ::is_fastapi_route_decorator -> ::is_fastapi_route -> {fastapi_non_annotated_dependency.rs, ruff/rules/unused_async.rs} (4 more hops, 2 terminal consumers). Additionally, roughly HALF of the 'hop-2' consumer sites for the other 10 wrapper families route through an intermediate private detector fn (e.g. delete_full_slice.rs::match_full_slice, repeated_append.rs::match_append, slice_copy.rs::match_list_full_slice, function_signature_change_in_3.rs::is_dict_expression, unnecessary_comprehension.rs::is_dict_items, dict_index_missing_items.rs::is_inferred_dict, key_in_dict.rs::key_in_dict [shared by 3 separate top-level rules -> 4 entries alone], flake8_use_pathlib/helpers.rs::is_file_descriptor [shared by 3 more rule files], unnecessary_from_float.rs::is_valid_argument_type, unnecessary_round.rs::rounded_and_ndigits, readlines_in_for.rs::readlines_in_iter [shared by 2 top-level rules], invalid_pathlib_with_suffix.rs::is_path_with_suffix_call, bad_str_strip_call.rs::ValueKind::from, multiple_starts_ends_with.rs::is_bound_to_tuple) before the real top-level rule fn -- a genuine extra hop per the letter of the (file,symbol) collapse rule that Fable's 'directly the D1 layer' framing did not anticipate. A rigorous full enumeration (all 12 wrappers x their real depth, + the 3 direct-impl files, + the 2 long tails) lands at an estimated 65-90+ distinct (file,symbol) gold sites -- FAILS the <=60 ceiling. PROPOSED NARROWING (this gold.json): restrict the target to the is_list+is_dict sub-closure only (the two most heavily-consumed, most illustrative wrapper families) -- fully source-verified, 28 sites, D1=25 (89%), comfortably inside [8,60]. Alternative narrowings the controller may prefer instead: (A) keep all 12 wrappers but prune the two long tails (is_type_var_like/is_fastapi_route) and the 3 direct-impl files -- still ~69 sites by my count, does NOT rescue admission; (B) is_list+is_dict+is_set+is_tuple (the four 'container' wrappers, since unnecessary_enumerate.rs and literal_membership.rs already exercise all four in one function) -- estimated ~35-40 sites; (C) a single wrapper only (is_dict alone) -- ~17 sites, thinner D1 illustration. Recommend (B) if the controller wants closer parity with the corpus's '~10 wrapper fan-out' framing; this file ships (is_list+is_dict) as the safest, fully-verified default.
